title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Through ICSP in South Sudan, households improved food and livelihood resilience through climate‑smart agriculture, including rice cultivation in flood‑prone areas and expanded vegetable production led by 123 trained lead farmers. These practices supported food production, seed saving and income diversification despite recurrent flooding and displacement. Food‑system outcomes improved, reflected in 55% acceptable Food Consumption Scores and 31% minimum dietary diversity. County authorities and community committees applied updated contingency plans and strengthened early‑warning actions, improving preparedness for climate‑driven shocks and enabling communities to protect food and livelihood systems more effectively.. Recurrent flooding, displacement and market instability leave families highly vulnerable to malnutrition in South Sudan. ICSP support strengthens household food and nutrition security by promoting community‑based nutrition practices, behaviour change support and targeted screening and referral.
